stem.text: Water passes across leaf tissues by different routes as a result of:

items: the pull transmitted by cohesive forces between water molecules.

stem.text: The diagram shows three routes by which water can travel.

stem.alt: Cross-section of a leaf showing cuticle, epidermal cells, palisade cells, cells of the spongy mesophyll, a xylem vessel and the atmosphere, with three routes drawn as arrows: route 1 dashed (apoplastic), route 2 dotted (vacuolar), route 3 solid (symplastic). The key is printed beside the drawing.

stem.text: Which row correctly identifies why water passes across leaf tissues by the different routes?
